title: Sick Leave
description: Granted for health-related issues. Maximum 10 days per year. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Casual Leave
description: Short-term leave for personal matters. Maximum 7 days per year. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Medical Leave
description: Extended leave for serious health conditions with medical proof. Maximum 30 days per year, unpaid after 10 days. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Maternity Leave
description: Leave for childbirth and recovery. Maximum 90 days. Applicable to female teachers and staff.

title: Paternity Leave
description: Leave for male staff after childbirth. Maximum 7 days. Applicable to male teachers and staff.

title: Bereavement Leave
description: Leave due to the death of an immediate family member. Maximum 5 days. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Marriage Leave
description: Leave granted for the employee’s own wedding. Maximum 10 days. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Study Leave
description: Leave for higher studies, research, or exams. Maximum 90 days. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Compensatory Leave
description: Time off in lieu of working on holidays or weekends. Maximum 2 days per month. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Half-Day Leave
description: Short leave for part of the working day. Maximum 4 hours per day. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Unpaid Leave
description: Leave without pay for personal reasons. Maximum 30 days per year. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Child Care Leave
description: Leave for taking care of young children. Maximum 60 days per year. Applicable to female teachers and staff.

title: Exam Leave (Students)
description: Leave granted to students during examinations. Maximum 15 days per term. Applicable to students.

title: Festival Leave
description: Leave granted during major religious or cultural festivals. Maximum 5 days per year. Applicable to teachers, staff, and students.

title: Quarantine Leave
description: Granted in case of contagious illness or government advisory. Maximum 14 days. Applicable to teachers, staff, and students.

title: Duty Leave
description: Leave for attending official school duties or events. Maximum 10 days per year. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Sabbatical Leave
description: Extended leave for professional development or research. Maximum 6 months. Applicable to teachers.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting Leave
description: Leave granted for parents to attend scheduled PTMs. Maximum 1 day per term. Applicable to students.

title: Relocation Leave
description: Leave for relocation purposes. Maximum 3 days. Applicable to teachers and staff.

title: Mental Health Leave
description: Leave for emotional or psychological wellbeing. Maximum 5 days per year. Applicable to teachers and staff.
